decision: Conditional A: complete original unitless artist-source preparation is worth doing. No producer, checker, viewer or native execution is admitted.
usable_deliverable: A complete editable paired boot source, component/topology records and OBJ, followed only after fresh source admission by its first fixed front/profile/rear observation. The source preparation must lead to actual artwork; another brief alone is insufficient.
research_question: Can explicitly authored interior, upper, rim, tongue/laces, counter, sole/heel and pair placement form a useful coarse brown lace-up ankle-boot starting point in its first three views?

findings.witness: Whole boots-proposal-v1.png: FRONT x70-389/y127-696 shows brown laces, rounded toe and dark sole; PROFILE x473-1289/y140-708 shows shaft/counter depth and low heel; REAR x1418-1713/y128-711 shows centered rear strip and open rim. PLAN.json lines9-11 explicitly own fictional interior, complete parts/joins and reflected winding. foot-source-map/RESULT.json lines22-24 records face owners sharing the foot-labelled skin.
findings.explanation: The raster supplies exterior design language, while its cavity, underside and paired construction remain unauthored. Complete fictional authorship adds editable artwork and avoids treating shared joint names as anatomical foot authority. It does not recover dimensions from these perspective views.

alternatives.A: Prepare the complete original nominal-volume and boot-part source.
alternatives.tradeoff: Can change a real editable-source and first-silhouette decision; requires full joins and part responsibility without earning anatomical fit.

alternatives.B: Retain the qualitative sheet and defer footwear authorship.
alternatives.tradeoff: Avoids further coarse-source effort, but leaves the interior and editable boot component unresolved.

findings.witness: PLAN.json line12 requires recognizable brown lace-up boot/rounded forefoot/shaft/low sole-heel/counter, yet allows laces or counter detail to remain open if reading fails; line15 says first render refusal stops.
findings.explanation: Before execution, the fresh source must distinguish required coarse class and component readability from optional fine finish. Otherwise a failed intended reading could be relabelled after capture. The sheet visibly supplies the required lacing and rear-counter language.

alternatives.A: Declare required coarse visual roles and optional fine details in the fresh literal source, preserving first-failure closure.
alternatives.tradeoff: Allows a useful coarse art starting point while keeping acceptance fixed before any job.

alternatives.B: Withhold execution if those roles cannot be owned consistently.
alternatives.tradeoff: Leaves the raster useful, but produces no editable-source acceptance.

stop_condition: Fresh finite complete producer/checker/viewer and source review are required. First substantive source, topology, test, render or required-reading failure closes this fixed method; no tuning, retry, retake or fallback.
limits: No physical last, anatomical foot, g050 correspondence, measurement, fit, materials, rig/morph/motion, accepted/default or full AAA qualification. No joint/BIN/world/skin/metric work performed. Existing closures and the checklist thirteen scoped checked/ten broad open goals remain. No current source or execution admission.
